entries.name: Arrested Sledge

counterPressure.note: Exactly one stat.modify line in the whole item (atom.might, low). atom.freezing (status.apply) and atom.retribution (resource.delta) are capabilities, not raw stat, so they sit outside the AE sum against cultivated's 2-3-affix rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: It never finishes the swing. The cold does that part for it.
entries.notes: Row 1 of the partition table: armament-primary / control. baseType resolves to item.humanoid-main-hand-b-003 (Lumbering Sledge, base-types/humanoid-armament-primary-b.json), role armament-primary confirmed on the entry itself. atom.freezing (C, shipped per atom-family-library.md 3.4) and atom.might are both role-legal for armament-primary already (g-affliction.json / g-attack.json roles lists) - no rule-break needed here; the item earns its slot on capability sequencing (freeze-lock, then a plain retribution rider) rather than on an illegal family. Name is themeAdjectivePools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'arrested' + nounPools['armament-primary.humanoid'] canonical 'sledge', pattern compound. Element omitted - freezing and retribution take no variant param.

entries.name: Harness of the Muster

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.vitality, low). atom.cleansing (status.clear) and atom.regeneration (resource.delta) are both capabilities and sit outside the raw-stat sum, keeping the item well under grafted's thin 1-2-affix baseline even with two capability lines.

entries.flavor: Rank insignia long since illegible. The straps still hold a line.
entries.notes: Row 2: core-guard / utility. baseType item.humanoid-torso-a-010 (Threadbare Harness, base-types/humanoid-core-guard-a.json), role core-guard confirmed. Both fixed families and the variance family are role-legal for core-guard already (g-sustain.json). Combat-posture tag set to 'utility' rather than the base type's own 'defensive', since the unique's identity capability (cleanse) reads as logistics support, not raw mitigation; kept 'fragile' from the base for the worn-thin flavour ('Threadbare'). Name is nounPools['core-guard.humanoid'] canonical 'harness' + conceptPools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'muster', pattern of-construct with the optional 'the'.

entries.name: Marching Yoke

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.fortitude, low). atom.sunbloom and atom.econ-muster are both resource.economy, not raw stat, so neither counts toward the AE sum against cultivated's baseline.

entries.flavor: Every step it takes is billed to someone still owed.
entries.notes: Row 3: ward-array / economy. baseType item.humanoid-shoulders-b-005 (Articulated Yoke, base-types/humanoid-ward-array-b.json), role ward-array confirmed. DELIBERATE RULE BREAK, ladder rung 2: ward-array has no role-legal resource.economy family at all (atom.sunbloom / atom.econ-muster are girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor-only per g-economy.json) and no role-legal stat.modify raw-stat family either - the only stat.modify roles list naming ward-array's normal survivability lever (atom.warding / atom.resilience) is commander-only ('standard' role), so atom.fortitude is also off the generator's legal list for this role. All three fixed/variance atoms sit in the item's own container, not a drawn pool, so none of this costs the architecture anything (same device the exemplar uses for atom.searing-strike on a head-guard role). Currency families read as pure economy mechanics (game currency 'sun'), not a thermal/warmth flavour cue, so the theme's own 'avoid warmth of any kind' line is not in tension with using them. Name is themeAdjectivePools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'marching' + nounPools['ward-array.humanoid'] canonical 'yoke', pattern compound.

entries.name: Halfstep

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.might, low). atom.searing-strike (resource.delta, elemental on-hit rider) and atom.lifesteal (resource.delta) are both capabilities, so the raw-stat sum stays a single low-band line against cultivated's baseline.

entries.flavor: One foot forward, frozen, and forward again. It has never once stepped back.
entries.notes: Row 4: armament-secondary / offense. baseType item.humanoid-off-hand-b-009 (Crushing Hubcap, base-types/humanoid-armament-secondary-b.json), role armament-secondary confirmed. All three families (searing-strike, might, lifesteal) are role-legal for armament-secondary already (g-on-hit.json / g-attack.json / g-on-hit.json), no rule-break required. element 'ice' matches the theme's sole elementAffinity (core.v1.json elements + themes.v1.json). Name is uniqueSetSeedPools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'halfstep', used atomically as a whole-token fusion name per naming.v1.json's collision-normalization rule 2a - not decomposed into two separately-drawn pool words, the same convention data/seed/items/sets/frostbitten-vanguard.json already uses for its own six set names. Not one of the six seed words that file consumed (stillmarch, coldstride, rimeguard is unused, frostcolumn, halfstep was unused there too before this entry, icebound, winterhold, latecommand unused, glacierward) - grepped both sets/ and charms/ before committing; no collision found.

entries.name: Unthawed Torc

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.mending, low). atom.warded (shield.grant) and atom.martyrdom (resource.delta) are capabilities, keeping the raw-stat sum well under grafted's 1-2-affix baseline.

entries.flavor: The ice around it has not moved in years. Neither has the will wearing it.
entries.notes: Row 5: jewel-major / survivability. baseType item.humanoid-neck-a-012 (Unadorned Torc, base-types/humanoid-jewel-major-a.json), role jewel-major confirmed. All three families (warded, mending, martyrdom) are role-legal for jewel-major already (g-sustain.json / g-on-death.json), no rule-break required. element 'ice' matches the theme's elementAffinity, same params.element pattern the exemplar and the set file both already use for atom.warded. Combat-posture tag set to 'defensive' (the shield-granting capability), diverging from the base type's own 'utility' tag deliberately - the two vocabularies are independent per entry-shapes.md's own finding. Name is themeAdjectivePools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'unthawed' + nounPools['jewel-major.humanoid'] canonical 'torc', pattern compound.

entries.name: Claw of the Standstill

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.ferocity, low). atom.mesmerizing and atom.venomous are both status.apply capabilities, not raw stat, keeping the item under grafted's thin baseline.

entries.flavor: It does not grip to hold. It grips to make you forget why you were moving.
entries.notes: Row 6: manipulator / control. baseType item.humanoid-hands-a-004 (Studded Claw, base-types/humanoid-manipulator-a.json), role manipulator confirmed. All three families (mesmerizing, ferocity, venomous) are role-legal for manipulator already (g-affliction.json / g-attack.json), no rule-break required - the control identity comes from stacking two C-category statuses (hypno then poison) rather than from an illegal family. Name is nounPools['manipulator.humanoid'] canonical 'claw' + conceptPools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'standstill', pattern of-construct with the optional 'the'.

entries.name: Numbline

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.fortitude, low). atom.gravedigging (grid.clear) and atom.deathblast (resource.delta) are capabilities, keeping the raw-stat sum to a single low line against cultivated's baseline.

entries.flavor: Marked ground, six paces back from wherever the column stopped counting.
entries.notes: Row 7: mantle / utility. baseType item.humanoid-back-b-005 (Overlapping Backpack, base-types/humanoid-back-b.json; mantle's humanoid name is 'back', file named accordingly), role mantle confirmed on the entry itself. DELIBERATE RULE BREAK, ladder rung 2: atom.gravedigging is retinue/jewel-major/jewel-minor-only per g-board.json, not legal for mantle in the generator's draw pool; both atoms sit in the item's own fixed container, not a drawn pool, so the break costs the architecture nothing. Considered atom.terraforming for the variance slot (same engineer-satchel read) but its family is fixed to boxType 'Lava' (g-board.json) - a scorched-earth/heat effect that collides with the theme's own avoid-list line 'warmth of any kind', so atom.deathblast with params.element 'ice' was used instead: an on-death frost burst, consistent with the theme's element affinity and with no thermal-flavour conflict. Name is uniqueSetSeedPools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'numbline', used atomically per naming.v1.json rule 2a - not one of the six seed words data/seed/items/sets/frostbitten-vanguard.json already spent, grepped before committing.

entries.name: Stiffened Crest

counterPressure.note: One stat.modify line only (atom.fortitude, low). atom.midas and atom.econ-bounty are both resource.economy, not raw stat, keeping the item under grafted's thin 1-2-affix baseline.

entries.flavor: Rank was worth something once. The coin it still finds proves it still is.
entries.notes: Row 8: head-guard / economy. baseType item.humanoid-head-a-007 (Studded Crest, base-types/humanoid-head-guard-a.json), role head-guard confirmed. DELIBERATE RULE BREAK, ladder rung 2: both atom.midas and atom.econ-bounty are girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor-only per g-economy.json, not legal for head-guard in the generator's draw pool; both sit in the item's own fixed container, not a drawn pool, so the break costs the architecture nothing - the same device the exemplar documents for atom.searing-strike on a crown/head-guard role. atom.fortitude is role-legal for head-guard already (g-life.json). Kept combat-posture tag 'defensive' from the base type since the piece is still physically head armour regardless of its economy rider. Name is themeAdjectivePools['frostbitten-vanguard'] canonical 'stiffened' + nounPools['head-guard.humanoid'] canonical 'crest', pattern compound.
